examples.pinyin: Wǒ sòng māma yì duǒ huā.
examples.english: I gave mom a flower.

examples.pinyin: Tā sòng wǒ huā hé yì běn shū.
examples.english: He gave me flowers and a book as presents.

examples.chinese: 妳想送她什麼？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng sòng tā shénme?
examples.english: What would you like to give her?

examples.chinese: 明天是友美的生日，我想送她一個禮物。

examples.english: It is Youmei’s birthday tomorrow; I would like to give her a gift.

examples.chinese: 友美愛看書，我想送她兩本中文書，你呢？
examples.pinyin: Yǒuměi ài kànshū, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā liǎng běn Zhōngwén shū, nǐ ne?
examples.english: Youmei loves reading. I would like to give her two books in Chinese as a gift. How about you?

examples.chinese: 我弟弟喜歡打棒球，我想送他一個棒球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi xǐhuān dǎ bàngqiú, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yí ge bàngqiú.
examples.english: My younger brother likes playing baseball, I’d like to give him a baseball as a gift.

examples.chinese: 她很喜歡花，你可以送她一些漂亮的花。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn xǐhuān huā, nǐ kěyǐ sòng tā yìxiē piàoliàng de huā.
examples.english: She likes flowers very much. You can give her some beautiful flowers.

examples.chinese: 後天是我朋友的生日，我想送他一個大蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Hòutiān shì wǒ péngyǒu de shēngrì, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yí ge dà dàngāo.
examples.english: The day after tomorrow is my friend’s birthday; I want to give him a big cake.

examples.chinese: 後天是我朋友的生日，我想要送他一個大蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Hòutiān shì wǒ péngyǒu de shēngrì, wǒ xiǎng yào sòng tā yí ge dà dàngāo.
examples.english: The day after tomorrow is my friend's birthday; I want to give him a big cake.

examples.chinese: 老師說要送我們書，我們都很高興。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō yào sòng wǒmen shū, wǒmen dōu hěn gāoxìng.
examples.english: The teacher said she/he is going to give us some books as gifts; we are all very happy.

examples.chinese: 他很喜歡喝茶，我想你可以送他一些台灣茶。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn xǐhuān hē chá, wǒ xiǎng nǐ kěyǐ sòng tā yīxiē Táiwān chá.
examples.english: He really likes drinking tea; I think you can give him some Taiwan tea.

examples.chinese: 明天是爸爸的生日，我要送他一個錶。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān shì bàba de shēngrì, wǒ yào sòng tā yī gè biǎo.
examples.english: Tomorrow is Dad's birthday; I want to give him a watch.

examples.chinese: 去年她送我一本書，今年我要送她一件衣服。
examples.pinyin: Qùnián tā sòng wǒ yī běn shū, jīnnián wǒ yào sòng tā yī jiàn yīfu.
examples.english: Last year she gave me a book; this year I want to give her a piece of clothing.

examples.chinese: 這是我朋友送我的生日卡片。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ péngyou sòng wǒ de shēngrì kǎpiàn.
examples.english: This is the birthday card my friend gave me.

examples.chinese: 他下個月就要回國了，我想送他一些小禮物。
examples.pinyin: Tā xià ge yuè jiù yào huí guó le, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yìxiē xiǎo lǐwù.
examples.english: He is about to return to his country next month; I want to give him some small gifts.

examples.chinese: 我同學送了我一張電影票，可是我沒有空去看。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tóngxué sòng le wǒ yì zhāng diànyǐng piào, kěshì wǒ méiyǒu kòng qù kàn.
examples.english: My classmate gave me a movie ticket, but I don't have time to go see it.

examples.chinese: 明天是老師的生日，我們要送他一個大蛋糕，給他過生日。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān shì lǎoshī de shēngrì, wǒmen yào sòng tā yī gè dà dàngāo, gěi tā guò shēngrì.
examples.english: Tomorrow is the teacher's birthday, we will give him a big cake to celebrate his birthday.

examples.chinese: 小黃要去便利商店領錢， 我請他幫我買杯咖啡。老闆去歐洲旅遊回來，買了荷蘭傳統的點心送給大家，叫我們去助理那裡領。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Huáng yào qù biànlì shāngdiàn lǐng qián, wǒ qǐng tā bāng wǒ mǎi bēi kāfēi. Lǎobǎn qù Ōuzhōu lǚyóu huílái, mǎile Hélán chuántǒng de diǎnxin sòng gěi dàjiā, jiào wǒmen qù zhùlǐ nàlǐ lǐng.
examples.english: Xiao Huang is going to the convenience store to withdraw money; I asked him to buy me a cup of coffee. The boss came back from a trip to Europe and bought traditional Dutch snacks to give to everyone, and told us to pick them up from the assistant.

examples.chinese: 小文為了得到超商送的小禮物，每天都特地去那裡買咖啡、三明治。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎowén wèile dédào chāoshāng sòng de xiǎo lǐwù, měitiān dōu tèdì qù nàlǐ mǎi kāfēi, sānmíngzhì.
examples.english: In order to get the small gift from the convenience store, Xiaowen specially goes there every day to buy coffee and sandwiches.

examples.chinese: 我烤了很多巧克力餅乾，用好看的紙包了一些送給鄰居。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ kǎo le hěn duō qiǎokèlì bǐnggān, yòng hǎokàn de zhǐ bāo le yìxiē sòng gěi línjū.
examples.english: I baked a lot of chocolate cookies and packed some in pretty paper to give to my neighbors.

examples.chinese: 我喜歡在網路商店購物，除了能省不少時間，還可以把商品送到家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān zài wǎnglù shāngdiàn gòuwù, chúle néng shěng bùshǎo shíjiān, hái kěyǐ bǎ shāngpǐn sòng dào jiā.
examples.english: I like to go shopping at online stores; besides saving a lot of time, they can also deliver the goods to your home.

examples.chinese: 超商常舉辦送小禮物或買一送一的活動，可是對王先生完全沒有吸引力。
examples.pinyin: Chāoshāng cháng jǔbàn sòng xiǎo lǐwù huò mǎi yī sòng yī de huódòng, kěshì duì Wáng xiānsheng wánquán méiyǒu xīyǐnlì.
examples.english: Convenience stores often hold promotions giving small gifts or buy-one-get-one-free, but they have completely no appeal to Mr. Wang.

examples.chinese: 張太太上個月生了一個女兒，我寫了一張卡片祝福她，希望孩子快快樂樂地長大。 我的孩子滿月時，收到很多朋友送的禮物和滿滿的祝福。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng tàitai shàng ge yuè shēng le yí ge nǚ'ér, wǒ xiě le yì zhāng kǎpiàn zhùfú tā, xīwàng háizi kuàikuàilèlè de zhǎngdà. Wǒ de háizi mǎnyuè shí, shōudào hěn duō péngyou sòng de lǐwù hé mǎnmǎn de zhùfú.
examples.english: Mrs. Zhang gave birth to a daughter last month. I wrote a card to bless her, hoping the child will grow up happily. When my child was one month old, we received many gifts from friends and full blessings.

examples.chinese: 除夕那天我送給父母一萬塊的紅包，祝福他們新年快樂，大吉大利！
examples.pinyin: Chúxī nà tiān wǒ sòng gěi fùmǔ yí wàn kuài de hóngbāo, zhùfú tāmen xīnnián kuàilè, dàjí dàlì!
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, I gave my parents a red envelope with ten thousand dollars, wishing them a happy New Year and great good fortune!

examples.chinese: 朋友的孩子滿月了，我想送他一份禮，祝福他平平安安地長大。
examples.pinyin: Péngyou de háizi mǎnyuè le, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yí fèn lǐ, zhùfú tā píngpíng'ān'ān de zhǎngdà.
examples.english: My friend's child has reached one month old. I want to give him a present, wishing him to grow up safely and soundly.

examples.chinese: 母親節那天，我親自做了一個大蛋糕，送給最親愛的媽媽。
examples.pinyin: Mǔqīnjié nà tiān, wǒ qīnzì zuò le yī gè dà dàngāo, sòng gěi zuì qīn'ài de māma.
examples.english: On Mother's Day, I personally made a big cake and gave it to my dearest mother.

examples.chinese: 每年春節時，爸爸都會送隔壁鄰居一盒蘋果，祝他們每天都平安、如意。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián chūnjié shí, bàba dōu huì sòng gébì línjū yī hé píngguǒ, zhù tāmen měi tiān dōu píng'ān, rúyì.
examples.english: Every year during Spring Festival, Dad gives the neighbor next door a box of apples, wishing them peace and that everything goes as they wish every day.

examples.chinese: 我去參加朋友的婚禮，除了送紅包，還祝福他們事事如意、早生貴子、永遠幸福。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù cānjiā péngyou de hūnlǐ, chúle sòng hóngbāo, hái zhùfú tāmen shìshì rúyì, zǎo shēng guìzǐ, yǒngyuǎn xìngfú.
examples.english: I went to attend a friend's wedding; besides giving a red envelope, I also wished them that everything goes as they wish, that they soon have a child, and that they be happy forever.

examples.chinese: A:這個玩具雖然可愛，但是不適合送給剛滿月的孩子，我們還是送紅包吧！ B:也好。送紅包也不錯。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhège wánjù suīrán kě'ài, dànshì bù shìhé sòng gěi gāng mǎn yuè de háizi, wǒmen háishì sòng hóngbāo ba! B: Yě hǎo. Sòng hóngbāo yě bùcuò.
examples.english: A: Although this toy is cute, it's not suitable to give to a child who has just turned one month old; we might as well give a red envelope! B: That's fine. Giving a red envelope is also good.

examples.chinese: 軍人用卡車把食物和生活用品送到災區，發給需要的民眾。
examples.pinyin: Jūnrén yòng kǎchē bǎ shíwù hé shēnghuó yòngpǐn sòng dào zāiqū, fā gěi xūyào de mínzhòng.
examples.english: Soldiers used trucks to deliver food and daily necessities to the disaster area and distribute them to the people in need.

examples.chinese: 我跟弟弟是雙胞胎，很多人都以為我是他，這樣的誤會我早就習慣了。A:何小姐只是我的鄰居，不是我的女朋友，大家都誤會了。 B:你對她很體貼，不但常送她上班，還常陪她逛街，大家對你們有誤會也是正常的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn dìdi shì shuāngbāotāi, hěn duō rén dōu yǐwéi wǒ shì tā, zhèyàng de wùhuì wǒ zǎo jiù xíguàn le. A: Hé xiǎojiě zhǐshì wǒ de línjū, bùshì wǒ de nǚpéngyǒu, dàjiā dōu wùhuì le. B: Nǐ duì tā hěn tǐtiē, bùdàn cháng sòng tā shàngbān, hái cháng péi tā guàngjiē, dàjiā duì nǐmen yǒu wùhuì yě shì zhèngcháng de.
examples.english: My younger brother and I are twins; many people think I am him, and I've long been used to this kind of misunderstanding. A: Miss He is just my neighbor, not my girlfriend; everyone has misunderstood. B: You are very considerate to her; not only do you often take her to work, but you also often accompany her shopping. It's normal for everyone to have a misunderstanding about you two.

examples.chinese: 去年生日爸爸送了我一輛自行車，從那天起，我就天天騎著它去上學。
examples.pinyin: Qùnián shēngrì bàba sòng le wǒ yī liàng zìxíngchē, cóng nà tiān qǐ, wǒ jiù tiāntiān qí zhe tā qù shàngxué.
examples.english: Last year on my birthday, Dad gave me a bicycle; from that day on, I have ridden it to school every day.

examples.chinese: 麗麗的老公在她生日那天，送了她九十九朵玫瑰花，好浪漫啊！
examples.pinyin: Lìlì de lǎogōng zài tā shēngrì nà tiān, sòng le tā jiǔshíjiǔ duǒ méiguīhuā, hǎo làngmàn a!
examples.english: Lili's husband gave her ninety-nine roses on her birthday; how romantic!

examples.chinese: 父母送我的結婚禮物很珍貴，包含了他們對我滿滿的祝福。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ sòng wǒ de jiéhūn lǐwù hěn zhēnguì, bāohán le tāmen duì wǒ mǎnmǎn de zhùfú.
examples.english: The wedding gift my parents gave me is very precious; it includes their full blessings for me.

examples.chinese: 溫小姐在白色情人節那天，送給情人一盒巧克力。
examples.pinyin: Wēn xiǎojiě zài Báisè Qíngrén Jié nà tiān, sòng gěi qíngrén yì hé qiǎokèlì.
examples.english: On White Day, Miss Wen gave her lover a box of chocolates.

examples.chinese: 我男朋友親手做了一張卡片，還買了一個漂亮的背包送給我， 他的心意讓我很感動。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nánpéngyou qīnshǒu zuò le yì zhāng kǎpiàn, hái mǎi le yí ge piàoliang de bēibāo sòng gěi wǒ, tā de xīnyì ràng wǒ hěn gǎndòng.
examples.english: My boyfriend personally made a card and also bought a beautiful backpack to give me; his kindly feelings moved me very much.

items.wordHook: a 辶(walking) courier crosses the 关(frontier pass) with a parcel → 送(give as a present).

examples.chinese: 女生和男生都喜歡去百貨公司買東西。
examples.pinyin: Nǚshēng hé nánshēng dōu xǐhuān qù bǎihuò gōngsī mǎi dōngxi.
examples.english: Both girls and boys like to go to the department store to shop.

examples.chinese: 百貨公司裡有很多衣服、鞋子和皮包，都是最新的，所以很多年輕女生喜歡到百貨公司去，漂亮的、流行的衣服，她們都想穿穿看。
examples.pinyin: Bǎihuògōngsī lǐ yǒu hěn duō yīfu, xiézi hé píbāo, dōu shì zuì xīn de, suǒyǐ hěn duō niánqīng nǚshēng xǐhuān dào bǎihuògōngsī qù, piàoliang de, liúxíng de yīfu, tāmen dōu xiǎng chuānchuān kàn.
examples.english: Clothes, shoes and purses in department stores are all the latest; therefore, many young ladies like to go there and try on both beautiful and trendy items.

examples.chinese: 小藍什麼都不怕，就是怕跟女生說話，只要一說話，他的臉就紅了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎolán shénme dōu bú pà, jiùshì pà gēn nǚshēng shuōhuà, zhǐyào yì shuōhuà, tā de liǎn jiù hóng le.
examples.english: Xiaolan is not afraid of anything; he is exactly afraid of talking to girls. As soon as he talks, his face turns red.

examples.chinese: 我哥哥開朗活潑、高大英俊，難怪有很多女生追求他。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēge kāilǎng huópō, gāodà yīngjùn, nánguài yǒu hěnduō nǚshēng zhuīqiú tā.
examples.english: My older brother is cheerful and lively, tall and handsome; no wonder many girls pursue him.

examples.chinese: 小章已經結婚了，還常常跟其他女生約會，真是太花心了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng yǐjīng jiéhūn le, hái chángcháng gēn qítā nǚshēng yuēhuì, zhēn shì tài huāxīn le.
examples.english: Xiao Zhang is already married, yet he often dates other girls; he is really too womanizing.

examples.chinese: A:聽說小金離婚了，你知道是怎麼回事嗎？ B:唉，這件事說起來都要怪小金，誰教他愛上了別的女生呢！
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō Xiǎo Jīn líhūn le, nǐ zhīdào shì zěnme huí shì ma? B: Āi, zhè jiàn shì shuō qǐlái dōu yào guài Xiǎo Jīn, shéi jiào tā ài shàng le bié de nǚshēng ne!
examples.english: A: I heard Xiao Jin got divorced. Do you know what happened? B: Sigh, as a matter of fact, it's all Xiao Jin's fault—who told him to fall in love with another girl!

items.wordHook: 女(female) + 生(birth) → a girl from birth; at school, a female student: 女生(girl).

examples.chinese: 聽說高鐵很快，你搭過沒有？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō gāotiě hěn kuài, nǐ dā guo méiyǒu?
examples.english: I heard the high-speed rail is very fast; have you ever taken it?

examples.chinese: 山本良介要從台北車站搭捷運回去。
examples.pinyin: Shānběn Liángjiè yào cóng Táiběi Chēzhàn dā jiéyùn huíqù.
examples.english: Yamamoto Ryosuke wants to take the MRT back from Taipei Main Station.

examples.chinese: 這是我第一次搭飛機，所以覺得很興奮。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì dā fēijī, suǒyǐ juéde hěn xīngfèn.
examples.english: This is my first time taking an airplane, so I feel very excited.

examples.chinese: 我要搭火車去東部，座位是3車16號。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào dā huǒchē qù dōngbù, zuòwèi shì sān chē shíliù hào.
examples.english: I'm going to take the train to the east; my seat is car 3, number 16.

examples.chinese: 搭火車的時候，我喜歡坐在窗戶旁邊的位子，邊聽音樂邊看風景。
examples.pinyin: Dā huǒchē de shíhou, wǒ xǐhuān zuò zài chuānghu pángbiān de wèizi, biān tīng yīnyuè biān kàn fēngjǐng.
examples.english: When taking the train, I like to sit in a seat by the window, listening to music while looking at the scenery.

examples.chinese: 我把搭車的日期、時間都記下來了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ dā chē de rìqī, shíjiān dōu jì xiàlái le.
examples.english: I have written down the date and time of the train ride.

examples.chinese: 因為我趕時間，所以得搭計程車去車站。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ gǎn shíjiān, suǒyǐ děi dā jìchéngchē qù chēzhàn.
examples.english: Because I am in a hurry, I have to take a taxi to the station.

examples.chinese: 搭公車時，年輕人應該把位子給老人坐，這是一種禮貌。
examples.pinyin: Dā gōngchē shí, niánqīngrén yīnggāi bǎ wèizi gěi lǎorén zuò, zhè shì yì zhǒng lǐmào.
examples.english: When taking the bus, young people should give their seats to the elderly; this is a kind of politeness.

examples.chinese: 從這裡走路回家有一點兒距離，而且現在還下著大雨，我們還是搭計程車算了。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ zǒulù huí jiā yǒu yīdiǎnr jùlí, érqiě xiànzài hái xiàzhe dàyǔ, wǒmen háishì dā jìchéngchē suàn le.
examples.english: Walking home from here is a bit of a distance, and it's still raining heavily now, so we might as well take a taxi.

examples.chinese: 背包客為了解省交通費，經常搭別人的車到下一個地點。
examples.pinyin: Bèibāokè wèile jiéshěng jiāotōng fèi, jīngcháng dā biérén de chē dào xià yí ge dìdiǎn.
examples.english: In order to save on transportation costs, backpackers often hitch rides in other people's cars to the next place.

examples.chinese: 我沒趕上最後一班公車，這下子只好搭計程車回家了。A:糟了，我不小心把隨身碟弄丟了，資料都存在裡面。 B:這下子我們的期末報告都白做了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ méi gǎnshàng zuìhòu yī bān gōngchē, zhè xiàzi zhǐhǎo dā jìchéngchē huí jiā le. A: Zāo le, wǒ bù xiǎoxīn bǎ suíshēndié nòng diū le, zīliào dōu cún zài lǐmiàn. B: Zhè xiàzi wǒmen de qīmò bàogào dōu bái zuò le.
examples.english: I didn't catch the last bus; now I have no choice but to take a taxi home. A: Oh no, I accidentally lost my USB drive; all the data is stored in it. B: Now all our final report work has been done in vain.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣鐵路局的網站訂票，一人最多只能訂六張搭車當天的票。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān Tiělùjú de wǎngzhàn dìng piào, yī rén zuìduō zhǐ néng dìng liù zhāng dā chē dāngtiān de piào.
examples.english: When booking tickets on the Taiwan Railways Administration website, each person can book at most six tickets for the day of travel.

examples.chinese: 搭飛機時，行李的重量是有限制的，大約一件25公斤。
examples.pinyin: Dā fēijī shí, xínglǐ de zhòngliàng shì yǒu xiànzhì de, dàyuē yī jiàn èrshíwǔ gōngjīn.
examples.english: When taking a plane, the weight of luggage is restricted, about 25 kilograms per piece.

examples.chinese: 你搭飛機去美國的話，得確認行李有沒有超過五十磅，多了就得付錢了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dā fēijī qù Měiguó de huà, děi quèrèn xínglǐ yǒu méiyǒu chāoguò wǔshí bàng, duō le jiù děi fù qián le.
examples.english: If you take a plane to the US, you have to confirm whether your luggage exceeds fifty pounds; if it's over, you'll have to pay.

examples.chinese: 過年時什麼都漲，連搭計程車的時候，車費都漲價了。
examples.pinyin: Guònián shí shénme dōu zhǎng, lián dā jìchéngchē de shíhou, chēfèi dōu zhǎngjià le.
examples.english: During Chinese New Year everything goes up in price; even when taking a taxi, the fare has increased.

examples.chinese: 為了旅客搭機安全，機場入境、出境時都要檢查行李。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le lǚkè dā jī ānquán, jīchǎng rùjìng, chūjìng shí dōu yào jiǎnchá xínglǐ.
examples.english: For passenger flight safety, luggage must be checked when entering and leaving the country at the airport.

examples.chinese: 今天搭捷運參加演唱會的民眾很多，車上擠得都不能轉身。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān dā jiéyùn cānjiā yǎnchànghuì de mínzhòng hěn duō, chē shàng jǐ de dōu bù néng zhuǎnshēn.
examples.english: There were many people taking the MRT to the concert today; the train was so crowded that you couldn't even turn around.

examples.english: That piece of clothing is a little old, but can still be worn for a long time.

examples.chinese: 我平常喜歡喝茶，有（的）時候喝一點兒咖啡。

examples.english: I usually like to drink tea; sometimes I drink a little coffee.

examples.chinese: 我現在不餓，只想吃一點兒水果。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài bú è, zhǐ xiǎng chī yìdiǎnr shuǐguǒ.
examples.english: I am not hungry now, I just want some fruit.

examples.chinese: 我想喝一點兒飲料。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng hē yìdiǎnr yǐnliào.
examples.english: I would like to have a little drink.

examples.chinese: 我們下個星期要學第十五課，我剛才先看了一點兒，書上有很多種動物，我覺得很有意思。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xià ge xīngqí yào xué dì shíwǔ kè, wǒ gāngcái xiān kàn le yìdiǎnr, shū shàng yǒu hěn duō zhǒng dòngwù, wǒ juéde hěn yǒuyìsi.
examples.english: We are going to learn lesson fifteen next week. I previewed a bit earlier just now. There are many kinds of animals in the book; I think it is very interesting.

examples.chinese: 我會給你三天的藥。你要記得多喝一點兒水，要是發燒了，就吃紅色的藥。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huì gěi nǐ sān tiān de yào. Nǐ yào jìde duō hē yìdiǎnr shuǐ, yàoshi fāshāo le, jiù chī hóngsè de yào.
examples.english: I will give you medicine for 3 days. Remember to drink plenty of water. If you have a fever, then take the red pill.

examples.chinese: 下個星期華語課有期中考，我有一點兒緊張，所以每天晚上都讀書，也練習寫字，希望下個星期的考試能考得很好。
examples.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqí Huáyǔ kè yǒu qízhōngkǎo, wǒ yǒu yìdiǎnr jǐnzhāng, suǒyǐ měi tiān wǎnshang dōu dúshū, yě liànxí xiězì, xīwàng xià ge xīngqí de kǎoshì néng kǎo de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: I will have the midterm exam for Chinese class next week. I am a bit nervous so I study every night and practice writing Chinese characters as well. I hope I can do well on the exam next week.

examples.chinese: 我覺得有一點兒累，我想回家休息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde yǒu yìdiǎnr lèi, wǒ xiǎng huí jiā xiūxí.
examples.english: I am feeling a bit tired, I want to go home for a rest.

examples.chinese: 咖啡、茶，我都喜歡。我也很餓，想吃一點兒東西。
examples.pinyin: Kāfēi, chá, wǒ dōu xǐhuān. Wǒ yě hěn è, xiǎng chī yìdiǎnr dōngxi.
examples.english: Coffee and tea, I like them both. I am also hungry; I would like to have some food.

examples.chinese: 我最近太胖了，應該多運動，少吃一點飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn tài pàng le, yīnggāi duō yùndòng, shǎo chī yīdiǎn fàn.
examples.english: I've gotten too fat recently; I should exercise more and eat a little less food.

examples.chinese: 我每天下午一點開始寫功課。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān xiàwǔ yì diǎn kāishǐ xiě gōngkè.
examples.english: I start writing homework at 1 p.m. every day.

examples.chinese: 這個學期開始，從星期一到星期五我都有華語課，每天從上午八點四十分到中午十二點上課，下午一點寫功課，有時候也跟同學練習說中文。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xuéqí kāishǐ, cóng xīngqí yī dào xīngqí wǔ, wǒ dōu yǒu Huáyǔ kè, měi tiān cóng shàngwǔ bā diǎn sìshí fēn dào zhōngwǔ shí’èr diǎn shàngkè, xiàwǔ yī diǎn xiě gōngkè, yǒushíhou yě gēn tóngxué liànxí shuō Zhōngwén.
examples.english: This semester I have Chinese class from 8:40 a.m. to 12:00 noon, Mondays to Fridays. I start to do my homework at 1:00 p.m., and sometimes I practice speaking Chinese with my classmates.

examples.chinese: 小陳很孝順，每個週末都去安養院陪父親聊天、散步，一點兒都不覺得辛苦。孝順父母的方法很多，最簡單的就是不讓他們擔心、生氣。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Chén hěn xiàoshùn, měi gè zhōumò dōu qù ānyǎngyuàn péi fùqīn liáotiān, sànbù, yīdiǎnr dōu bù juéde xīnkǔ. Xiàoshùn fùmǔ de fāngfǎ hěn duō, zuì jiǎndān de jiùshì bù ràng tāmen dānxīn, shēngqì.
examples.english: Xiao Chen is very filial; every weekend he goes to the nursing home to chat and take walks with his father, and doesn't feel the least bit tired. There are many ways to be filial to parents; the simplest is to not make them worry or get angry.

examples.chinese: 從這裡走路回家有一點兒距離，而且現在還下著大雨，我們還是搭計程車算了。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ zǒulù huí jiā yǒu yīdiǎnr jùlí, érqiě xiànzài hái xiàzhe dàyǔ, wǒmen háishì dā jìchéngchē suàn le.
examples.english: Walking home from here is a bit of a distance, and it's still raining heavily now, so we might as well take a taxi.

examples.chinese: 媽媽今天要加班，我得照顧妹妹，不能不早一點兒回家。
examples.pinyin: Māma jīntiān yào jiābān, wǒ děi zhàogù mèimei, bùnéngbù zǎo yīdiǎnr huí jiā.
examples.english: Mom has to work overtime today, and I have to take care of my little sister, so I cannot but go home a bit earlier.

examples.chinese: 那所非常有名的大學每年只錄取一千名新生，除了得成績夠好，還需要一點兒運氣才進得去。
examples.pinyin: Nà suǒ fēicháng yǒumíng de dàxué měi nián zhǐ lùqǔ yīqiān míng xīnshēng, chúle děi chéngjì gòu hǎo, hái xūyào yīdiǎnr yùnqi cái jìn de qù.
examples.english: That very famous university only admits one thousand new students each year; besides needing good enough grades, you also need a bit of luck to get in.

examples.chinese: 小韓早晚都打工，是因為想多存一些錢，早一點完成出國念書的夢想。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Hán zǎowǎn dōu dǎgōng, shì yīnwèi xiǎng duō cún yìxiē qián, zǎo yìdiǎn wánchéng chūguó niànshū de mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: Xiao Han works part-time in the morning and evening because he wants to save more money and fulfill his dream of studying abroad earlier.

examples.chinese: 錢老闆滿腦子都是工作，每天只想著怎麼讓公司成長得快一點。
examples.pinyin: Qián lǎobǎn mǎn nǎozi dōu shì gōngzuò, měitiān zhǐ xiǎngzhe zěnme ràng gōngsī chéngzhǎng de kuài yīdiǎn.
examples.english: Boss Qian's mind is full of work; every day he only thinks about how to make the company grow a bit faster.

examples.chinese: 客人：這雙皮鞋我穿起來太緊了， 可以幫我換大一點的嗎？ 店員：沒問題，我幫你拿大一號的。
examples.pinyin: Kèrén: Zhè shuāng píxié wǒ chuān qǐlái tài jǐn le, kěyǐ bāng wǒ huàn dà yīdiǎn de ma? Diànyuán: Méi wèntí, wǒ bāng nǐ ná dà yī hào de.
examples.english: Customer: This pair of leather shoes is too tight for me; can you help me exchange them for a bigger size? Clerk: No problem, I'll get you a size larger.

examples.chinese: 那位老先生走著走著，路旁的樹木突然倒了下來，他差一點就受傷了。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎo xiānshēng zǒuzhe zǒuzhe, lù páng de shùmù tūrán dǎo le xiàlái, tā chà yīdiǎn jiù shòushāng le.
examples.english: That elderly gentleman was walking and walking, when suddenly the trees beside the road fell down; he was almost injured.

examples.chinese: 只有集合大家的力量，有錢出錢、有力出力，才能幫助災民早一點恢復正常生活。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu jíhé dàjiā de lìliàng, yǒu qián chū qián, yǒu lì chū lì, cái néng bāngzhù zāimín zǎo yìdiǎn huīfù zhèngcháng shēnghuó.
examples.english: Only by gathering everyone's strength—those with money contributing money, those with strength contributing strength—can we help the disaster victims return to normal life sooner.

examples.chinese: 既然你那麼喜歡張小姐，就應該主動一點，約她去看電影、吃個飯什麼的。
examples.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ nàme xǐhuān Zhāng xiǎojiě, jiù yīnggāi zhǔdòng yīdiǎn, yuē tā qù kàn diànyǐng, chī ge fàn shénme de.
examples.english: Since you like Miss Zhang so much, you should take the initiative a bit more—ask her out to a movie, a meal, or something.

examples.chinese: 不管是誰，如果失去了親愛的家人，一定會很傷心、很痛苦，這是很自然的。那個女演員演戲的樣子很自然，一點也不誇張，難怪導演很欣賞她。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn shì shéi, rúguǒ shīqù le qīn'ài de jiārén, yīdìng huì hěn shāngxīn, hěn tòngkǔ, zhè shì hěn zìrán de. Nàge nǚ yǎnyuán yǎnxì de yàngzi hěn zìrán, yīdiǎn yě bù kuāzhāng, nánguài dǎoyǎn hěn xīnshǎng tā.
examples.english: No matter who it is, if they lose a beloved family member, they will certainly be very sad and in great pain; this is very natural. That actress's acting is very natural, not exaggerated at all; no wonder the director appreciates her.

examples.chinese: 大雄從小個性就很被動，別人要求的事他才做，父母跟老師都希望他可以主動一點。
examples.pinyin: Dàxióng cóngxiǎo gèxìng jiù hěn bèidòng, biérén yāoqiú de shì tā cái zuò, fùmǔ gēn lǎoshī dōu xīwàng tā kěyǐ zhǔdòng yīdiǎn.
examples.english: Daxiong has been passive in personality since childhood; he only does things when others ask him to. His parents and teachers all hope he can be a bit more proactive.

examples.chinese: 要是你覺得這盤菜的味道太淡了，可以加一點醬料。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ juéde zhè pán cài de wèidào tài dàn le, kěyǐ jiā yìdiǎn jiàngliào.
examples.english: If you feel this dish's flavor is too light, you can add a little sauce.

examples.chinese: 許經理有兩點值得我們學習，第一點是做事仔細，第二點是有耐心。你的白襯衫上面有一個黑點，快脫下來，我幫你洗一洗。
examples.pinyin: Xǔ jīnglǐ yǒu liǎng diǎn zhídé wǒmen xuéxí, dì yī diǎn shì zuòshì zǐxì, dì èr diǎn shì yǒu nàixīn. Nǐ de bái chènshān shàngmiàn yǒu yī gè hēi diǎn, kuài tuō xiàlái, wǒ bāng nǐ xǐ yī xǐ.
examples.english: Manager Xu has two points worth learning from: the first point is that he is careful in his work, and the second point is that he is patient. There is a black spot on your white shirt; quickly take it off, and I'll help you wash it.

examples.chinese: 何先生早就習慣了單身生活，一點都不想結婚。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiānsheng zǎo jiù xíguàn le dānshēn shēnghuó, yīdiǎn dōu bù xiǎng jiéhūn.
examples.english: Mr. He has long been accustomed to single life and doesn't want to get married at all.

examples.chinese: 每當包太太心情不好的時候，包先生就會說笑話來逗她，讓她開心一點。
examples.pinyin: Měidāng Bāo tàitai xīnqíng bù hǎo de shíhou, Bāo xiānsheng jiù huì shuō xiàohua lái dòu tā, ràng tā kāixīn yìdiǎn.
examples.english: Whenever Mrs. Bao is in a bad mood, Mr. Bao will tell jokes to tease her and make her a little happier.

examples.chinese: 小張已經四十歲了，父母盼望他快點找到結婚對象，他卻一點也不著急。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎozhāng yǐjīng sìshí suì le, fùmǔ pànwàng tā kuài diǎn zhǎodào jiéhūn duìxiàng, tā què yīdiǎn yě bù zháojí.
examples.english: Xiaozhang is already forty years old; his parents yearn for him to quickly find a marriage partner, but he is not anxious at all.

examples.chinese: 因為強烈颱風的關係，機場已經關了，等風小一點才會再開放。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi qiángliè táifēng de guānxì, jīchǎng yǐjīng guān le, děng fēng xiǎo yīdiǎn cái huì zài kāifàng.
examples.english: Because of the strong typhoon, the airport has already closed; it will open again only after the wind gets a little weaker.

examples.chinese: 請把洗衣機放在這邊，冰箱放在那邊。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ xǐyījī fàng zài zhèbiān, bīngxiāng fàng zài nàbiān.
examples.english: Please put the washing machine here and the refrigerator there.

examples.chinese: 他想多了解一點兒台灣文化，所以決定來台灣留學。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng duō liǎojiě yìdiǎnr Táiwān wénhuà, suǒyǐ juédìng lái Táiwān liúxué.
examples.english: He wants to understand a little more about Taiwanese culture, so he decided to come to Taiwan to study abroad.

examples.chinese: 旅行的目的除了看風景，還可以了解那個地方的文化特色。
examples.pinyin: Lǚxíng de mùdì chúle kàn fēngjǐng, hái kěyǐ liǎojiě nàge dìfāng de wénhuà tèsè.
examples.english: The purpose of travel, besides seeing the scenery, is also to understand the cultural features of that place.

examples.chinese: 他為了研究環境和文化的關係，用了不少時間。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèile yánjiū huánjìng hé wénhuà de guānxì, yòng le bùshǎo shíjiān.
examples.english: In order to research the relationship between environment and culture, he spent quite a lot of time.

examples.chinese: 太陽每天都是從東方出來，從西方下去的。以凡學了中文以後，他覺得東方文化和西方文化很不一樣。
examples.pinyin: 1. Tàiyáng měitiān dōu shì cóng dōngfāng chūlái, cóng xīfāng xiàqù de. 2. Yǐfán xué le Zhōngwén yǐhòu, tā juéde dōngfāng wénhuà hé xīfāng wénhuà hěn bù yíyàng.

examples.pinyin: 1. Tàiyáng měitiān dōu shì cóng dōngfāng chūlái, cóng xīfāng xiàqù de. 2. Yǐfán xué le Zhōngwén yǐhòu, tā juéde dōngfāng wénhuà hé xīfāng wénhuà hěn bù yíyàng.
examples.english: 1. The sun every day comes out from the east and goes down in the west. 2. After Yifan learned Chinese, he felt that Eastern culture and Western culture are very different.

examples.chinese: 這本書的內容很有意思，介紹了很多義大利的飲食文化。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū de nèiróng hěn yǒu yìsi, jièshàole hěn duō Yìdàlì de yǐnshí wénhuà.
examples.english: The content of this book is very interesting; it introduces a lot of Italian food culture.

examples.chinese: 世界文化日那天，你想表演什麼？
examples.pinyin: Shìjiè Wénhuà Rì nà tiān, nǐ xiǎng biǎoyǎn shénme?
examples.english: On World Culture Day, what do you want to perform?

examples.chinese: 出國留學有很多好處，除了學習語言，還有文化交流的機會。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó liúxué yǒu hěn duō hǎochù, chúle xuéxí yǔyán, hái yǒu wénhuà jiāoliú de jīhuì.
examples.english: Studying abroad has many benefits; besides learning a language, there are also opportunities for cultural exchange.

examples.chinese: 華語文中心的學生邀請台灣朋友來參加世界文化日的活動。
examples.pinyin: Huáyǔwén zhōngxīn de xuésheng yāoqǐng Táiwān péngyou lái cānjiā shìjiè wénhuà rì de huódòng.
examples.english: The students at the Mandarin Learning Center invited Taiwanese friends to come participate in the World Culture Day activities.

examples.chinese: 這個影片介紹了亞洲的飲食文化。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yǐngpiàn jièshào le Yàzhōu de yǐnshí wénhuà.
examples.english: This video introduced Asia's food culture.

examples.chinese: 出國學習語言可以了解外國的文化，再說，也可以認識外國朋友，非常值得。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó xuéxí yǔyán kěyǐ liǎojiě wàiguó de wénhuà, zàishuō, yě kěyǐ rènshi wàiguó péngyou, fēicháng zhídé.
examples.english: Going abroad to study a language can help you understand foreign cultures; moreover, you can also meet foreign friends—it's very worthwhile.

examples.chinese: 東西方的文化差異很大，像穿著、音樂、哲學等風格都不相同。
examples.pinyin: Dōngxīfāng de wénhuà chāyì hěn dà, xiàng chuānzhuó, yīnyuè, zhéxué děng fēnggé dōu bù xiāngtóng.
examples.english: The cultural differences between East and West are great; styles such as apparel, music, and philosophy are all different.

examples.chinese: 不少外國人說，臺灣最大的魅力是人們能夠接受不同的文化、語言和想法，所以在臺灣生活非常自在。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo wàiguórén shuō, Táiwān zuì dà de mèilì shì rénmen nénggòu jiēshòu bùtóng de wénhuà, yǔyán hé xiǎngfǎ, suǒyǐ zài Táiwān shēnghuó fēicháng zìzài.
examples.english: Many foreigners say that Taiwan's greatest charm is that people can accept different cultures, languages, and ideas, so living in Taiwan is very comfortable.

examples.chinese: 這堂課的內容跟文化有關，所以老師把教學重心放在介紹各國的文化特色。
examples.pinyin: Zhè táng kè de nèiróng gēn wénhuà yǒuguān, suǒyǐ lǎoshī bǎ jiàoxué zhòngxīn fàng zài jièshào gè guó de wénhuà tèsè.
examples.english: The content of this class is related to culture, so the teacher put the teaching focus on introducing the cultural characteristics of various countries.

examples.chinese: 華語中心除了有培養學生中文能力的課程，還安排了文化課，讓課程更豐富。
examples.pinyin: Huáyǔ zhōngxīn chúle yǒu péiyǎng xuéshēng Zhōngwén nénglì de kèchéng, hái ānpái le wénhuà kè, ràng kèchéng gèng fēngfù.
examples.english: The Mandarin center, besides having courses that develop students' Chinese ability, also arranged culture classes, making the courses richer.

examples.chinese: 有人信上帝，有人不信。但在東西方的文化中，「上帝」的角色都是很重要的。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén xìn Shàngdì, yǒu rén bú xìn. Dàn zài dōng xīfāng de wénhuà zhōng, “Shàngdì” de juésè dōu shì hěn zhòngyào de.
examples.english: Some people believe in God, and some do not. But in both Eastern and Western cultures, the role of “God” is very important.

examples.chinese: 出國當交換學生的目的，不僅僅是為了學習語言，更重要的是了解當地的文化。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó dāng jiāohuàn xuéshēng de mùdì, bù jǐnjǐn shì wèile xuéxí yǔyán, gèng zhòngyào de shì liǎojiě dāngdì de wénhuà.
examples.english: The purpose of going abroad as an exchange student is not merely to study a language; more importantly, it is to understand the local culture.

examples.chinese: 這次亞洲文化展，除了樂器表演，還有傳統服裝試穿活動，歡迎各位來參觀。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì Yàzhōu wénhuà zhǎn, chúle yuèqì biǎoyǎn, hái yǒu chuántǒng fúzhuāng shìchuān huódòng, huānyíng gèwèi lái cānguān.
examples.english: This Asian Culture Exhibition, in addition to musical instrument performances, also has traditional clothing try-on activities; everyone is welcome to visit.

examples.chinese: 那個美國人每天看臺灣的連續劇，一方面學習中文，一方面了解臺灣的生活文化。
examples.pinyin: Nàge Měiguórén měitiān kàn Táiwān de liánxùjù, yìfāngmiàn xuéxí Zhōngwén, yìfāngmiàn liǎojiě Táiwān de shēnghuó wénhuà.
examples.english: That American watches Taiwanese TV series every day: on one hand to learn Chinese, on the other hand to understand Taiwanese life and culture.

examples.chinese: 小張喜歡閱讀法國的文學作品，透過這些作品，讓他了解了法國文化的特色。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng xǐhuan yuèdú Fǎguó de wénxué zuòpǐn, tòuguò zhèxiē zuòpǐn, ràng tā liǎojiě le Fǎguó wénhuà de tèsè.
examples.english: Xiao Zhang likes to read French literary works; through these works, he has come to understand the characteristics of French culture.

examples.chinese: 在華人社會中，「龍」具有重要的文化意義，但「龍」其實是不存在的。
examples.pinyin: Zài Huárén shèhuì zhōng, "lóng" jùyǒu zhòngyào de wénhuà yìyì, dàn "lóng" qíshí shì bù cúnzài de.
examples.english: In Chinese society, the "dragon" has important cultural significance, but the "dragon" actually does not exist.

examples.chinese: 博物館裡的東西非常寶貴， 它們具有民族和文化的價值， 沒辦法用錢算清楚的。每個人的生命價值都是一樣的，不應該為了自己的利益而犧牲別人。
examples.pinyin: 1. Bówùguǎn lǐ de dōngxi fēicháng bǎoguì, tāmen jùyǒu mínzú hé wénhuà de jiàzhí, méi bànfǎ yòng qián suàn qīngchu de. 2. Měi gè rén de shēngmìng jiàzhí dōu shì yīyàng de, bù yīnggāi wèile zìjǐ de lìyì ér xīshēng biérén.
examples.english: 1. The things in the museum are very precious; they have ethnic and cultural value and cannot be calculated clearly with money. 2. Everyone's value of life is the same; one should not sacrifice others for one's own interests.

examples.chinese: 為了提高這座城市的文化水準，市長積極建設藝術表演中心、圖書館等公共空間。像機場、高鐵、捷運這類公共交通建設，都需要很多經費才能完成。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígāo zhè zuò chéngshì de wénhuà shuǐzhǔn, shìzhǎng jījí jiànshè yìshù biǎoyǎn zhōngxīn, túshūguǎn děng gōnggòng kōngjiān. Xiàng jīchǎng, gāotiě, jiéyùn zhè lèi gōnggòng jiāotōng jiànshè, dōu xūyào hěn duō jīngfèi cái néng wánchéng.
examples.english: In order to raise the cultural level of this city, the mayor actively builds public spaces such as art performance centers and libraries. Public transportation construction such as airports, high-speed rail, and MRT requires a lot of funds to complete.

examples.chinese: 文化中心跟大學合辦了一場音樂會，吸引不少民眾參加。
examples.pinyin: Wénhuà zhōngxīn gēn dàxué hé bàn le yī chǎng yīnyuèhuì, xīyǐn bùshǎo mínzhòng cānjiā.
examples.english: The cultural center and the university jointly held a concert, attracting many people to attend.

examples.chinese: 他對亞洲文化相當有興趣，計畫將來走遍全亞洲。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì Yàzhōu wénhuà xiāngdāng yǒu xìngqù, jìhuà jiānglái zǒu biàn quán Yàzhōu.
examples.english: He is quite interested in Asian culture and plans to travel all over Asia in the future.

examples.chinese: 他透過古典文學來討論古代與現代的文化差異。
examples.pinyin: Tā tòuguò gǔdiǎn wénxué lái tǎolùn gǔdài yǔ xiàndài de wénhuà chāyì.
examples.english: He discusses the cultural differences between ancient and modern times through classical literature.

examples.chinese: 解決種族之間因文化差異產生的問題，最好的辦法就是互相尊重。
examples.pinyin: Jiějué zhǒngzú zhījiān yīn wénhuà chāyì chǎnshēng de wèntí, zuì hǎo de bànfǎ jiùshì hùxiāng zūnzhòng.
examples.english: To solve problems that arise between races due to cultural differences, the best approach is mutual respect.

examples.chinese: 教授說了很多哲學的道理，我覺得很難懂。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoshòu shuō le hěn duō zhéxué de dàolǐ, wǒ juéde hěn nán dǒng.
examples.english: The professor talked about many philosophical principles—I find them hard to understand.

examples.chinese: A:這麼晚了，你別喝咖啡，要不然會睡不著？ B:你說得有道理，那我喝水吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhème wǎn le, nǐ bié hē kāfēi, yàobùrán huì shuì bù zháo? B: Nǐ shuō de yǒu dàolǐ, nà wǒ hē shuǐ ba.
examples.english: A: It's so late—don't drink coffee, or else you won't be able to sleep. B: What you say makes sense—then I'll drink water.

examples.chinese: 父母應該好好地教育孩子，讓他們明白做人、做事的道理。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ yīnggāi hǎohǎo de jiàoyù háizi, ràng tāmen míngbai zuòrén, zuòshì de dàolǐ.
examples.english: Parents should educate their children well, so that they understand the principles of conducting oneself and doing things.

examples.chinese: 那位大明星身上穿的、手上戴的 ，都是有名的牌子。經理做事態度認真、負責，我從他身上學到了很多做人做事的道理。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi dà míngxīng shēnshang chuān de, shǒushang dài de, dōu shì yǒumíng de páizi. Jīnglǐ zuòshì tàidù rènzhēn, fùzé, wǒ cóng tā shēnshang xué dào le hěn duō zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ.
examples.english: What that big star wears on her body and on her hands are all famous brands. The manager's work attitude is serious and responsible; I have learned many principles of how to conduct myself and do things from him.

examples.chinese: 有一些病人不肯乖乖吃藥，護理師得有耐心，慢慢地跟他們講道理。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē bìngrén bù kěn guāiguāi chī yào, hùlǐshī děi yǒu nàixīn, mànman de gēn tāmen jiǎng dàolǐ.
examples.english: Some patients refuse to take their medicine obediently, so nurses must have patience and slowly reason with them.

examples.chinese: 他畢竟是個小孩子，還不懂做人做事的道理，等他長大就會明白了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bìjìng shì ge xiǎoháizi, hái bù dǒng zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ, děng tā zhǎngdà jiù huì míngbai le.
examples.english: After all, he is a child and doesn't yet understand the principles of how to conduct himself and do things; when he grows up, he will understand.

examples.chinese: 父母除了教導孩子做人做事的道理，也應該肯定他們的表現，讓他們更有自信。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ chúle jiàodǎo háizi zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ, yě yīnggāi kěndìng tāmen de biǎoxiàn, ràng tāmen gèng yǒu zìxìn.
examples.english: Besides teaching children the principles of how to conduct themselves and do things, parents should also affirm their performance so that they have more confidence.

examples.chinese: 站在老闆背後的那個人已經通過了面試，明天就要來上班了。「每個成功男人的背後，都有一個偉大的女人。」你覺得這句話有道理嗎？
examples.pinyin: 1. Zhàn zài lǎobǎn bèihòu de nàge rén yǐjīng tōngguò le miànshì, míngtiān jiù yào lái shàngbān le. 2. Měi ge chénggōng nánrén de bèihòu, dōu yǒu yí ge wěidà de nǚrén. Nǐ juéde zhè jù huà yǒu dàolǐ ma?
examples.english: 1. The person standing behind the boss has already passed the interview and will come to work tomorrow. 2. Behind every successful man, there is a great woman. Do you think this saying makes sense?

examples.chinese: 他說的話都很有道理，不是廢話，只是你聽不進去而已。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō de huà dōu hěn yǒu dàolǐ, bù shì fèihuà, zhǐshì nǐ tīng bù jìnqù éryǐ.
examples.english: What he says is all very reasonable, not nonsense; it's just that you won't take it in.

examples.chinese: 教授學生做人的道理與教授知識同樣重要。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoshòu xuéshēng zuòrén de dàolǐ yǔ jiàoshòu zhīshì tóngyàng zhòngyào.
examples.english: Instructing students in the principles of how to conduct themselves is just as important as instructing them in knowledge.

examples.chinese: A:那所大學雖然相當著名，但我國政府不承認他們的學位(academic degree)。B:許多國家都承認那所大學的學位，貴國哪裡有不承認的道理？
examples.pinyin: A: Nà suǒ dàxué suīrán xiāngdāng zhùmíng, dàn wǒguó zhèngfǔ bù chéngrèn tāmen de xuéwèi. B: Xǔduō guójiā dōu chéngrèn nà suǒ dàxué de xuéwèi, guìguó nǎlǐ yǒu bù chéngrèn de dàolǐ?
examples.english: A: Although that university is quite famous, our government does not recognize their academic degrees. B: Many countries recognize that university's degrees—how could your esteemed country have any reason not to recognize them?

examples.chinese: 那位教授看報告看得很仔細，你可不能亂寫。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi jiàoshòu kàn bàogào kàn de hěn zǐxì, nǐ kě bù néng luàn xiě.
examples.english: That professor reads reports very carefully; you must not write carelessly.

examples.chinese: 小藍看起來糊里糊塗的，其實做起事來仔細得很。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎolán kàn qǐlái húlǐhútú de, qíshí zuò qǐ shì lái zǐxì de hěn.
examples.english: Xiaolan looks muddle-headed, but actually she is very careful when doing things.

examples.chinese: 許經理有兩點值得我們學習，第一點是做事仔細，第二點是有耐心。你的白襯衫上面有一個黑點，快脫下來，我幫你洗一洗。
examples.pinyin: Xǔ jīnglǐ yǒu liǎng diǎn zhídé wǒmen xuéxí, dì yī diǎn shì zuòshì zǐxì, dì èr diǎn shì yǒu nàixīn. Nǐ de bái chènshān shàngmiàn yǒu yī gè hēi diǎn, kuài tuō xiàlái, wǒ bāng nǐ xǐ yī xǐ.
examples.english: Manager Xu has two points worth learning from: the first point is that he is careful in his work, and the second point is that he is patient. There is a black spot on your white shirt; quickly take it off, and I'll help you wash it.

examples.chinese: 我每次寫完考卷都會仔細檢查一遍，要是發現錯誤就馬上改過來。費太太結婚後才發現這是個錯誤決定，她不知道該怎麼辦才好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi cì xiě wán kǎojuàn dōu huì zǐxì jiǎnchá yí biàn, yàoshi fāxiàn cuòwù jiù mǎshàng gǎi guòlái. Fèi tàitai jiéhūn hòu cái fāxiàn zhè shì ge cuòwù juédìng, tā bù zhīdào gāi zěnme bàn cái hǎo.
examples.english: Every time I finish writing an exam paper, I carefully check it once; if I find a mistake, I immediately correct it. Mrs. Fei only discovered after marriage that this was a wrong decision, and she doesn't know what to do.

examples.chinese: A:我到底該怎麼做才能讓老闆滿意？ B:你太驕傲、個性太急， 做事也不夠仔細。總之， 先把自己的缺點改掉吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ dàodǐ gāi zěnme zuò cái néng ràng lǎobǎn mǎnyì? B: Nǐ tài jiāo'ào, gèxìng tài jí, zuòshì yě bù gòu zǐxì. Zǒngzhī, xiān bǎ zìjǐ de quēdiǎn gǎi diào ba.
examples.english: A: What on earth should I do to satisfy the boss? B: You are too arrogant, your personality is too impatient, and you are not careful enough in doing things. In short, first change your shortcomings.

examples.chinese: 會議資料的分類不必太仔細，分得簡單清楚就行了。
examples.pinyin: Huìyì zīliào de fēnlèi bùbì tài zǐxì, fēn de jiǎndān qīngchu jiù xíng le.
examples.english: The classification of meeting materials doesn't need to be too detailed; as long as it's simple and clear, that's fine.

examples.chinese: 公司的工作須知訂得非常詳細，不過從來沒有員工仔細看完。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de gōngzuò xūzhī dìng de fēicháng xiángxì, bùguò cónglái méiyǒu yuángōng zǐxì kàn wán.
examples.english: The company's work guidelines are set out in great detail, but no employee has ever read them carefully all the way through.

examples.chinese: 這幅設計圖畫得很仔細，畫圖的人應該相當細心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fú shèjì tú huà de hěn zǐxì, huà tú de rén yīnggāi xiāngdāng xìxīn.
examples.english: This design drawing is drawn very carefully; the person who drew it must be quite meticulous.

examples.chinese: 仔細地思考是為了防止做出錯誤的決定。
examples.pinyin: Zǐxì de sīkǎo shì wèile fángzhǐ zuò chū cuòwù de juédìng.
examples.english: Careful thinking is to prevent making wrong decisions.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠生產的皮鞋、皮帶，不但品質好，價錢也不貴。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng shēngchǎn de píxié, pídài, bùdàn pǐnzhí hǎo, jiàqián yě bù guì.
examples.english: The leather shoes and belts that that factory produces are not only good in quality, but also not expensive in price.

items.wordHook: Combining 皮(skin) and 帶(belt): 皮帶 means leather belt.

items.key: ["B3L16-2-25","無論如何","無論如何","无论如何","Conj"]

examples.chinese: 照顧還沒成年的孩子是父母應盡的責任，無論如何，既然生了就該養他、教導他。
examples.pinyin: Zhàogù hái méi chéngnián de háizi shì fùmǔ yīng jìn de zérèn, wúlùnrúhé, jìrán shēng le jiù gāi yǎng tā, jiàodǎo tā.
examples.english: Taking care of children who are not yet adults is a responsibility parents should fulfill; in any case, since you gave birth to them, you should raise them and educate them.

items.wordHook: Having 無(no) doubt what 論(debate) arises or 如(if) 何(what) happens: 無論如何 means in any case.

examples.chinese: 他這個月花了太多錢，因此連水電費、房租都繳不出來。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhège yuè huā le tài duō qián, yīncǐ lián shuǐdiànfèi, fángzū dōu jiǎo bù chūlái.
examples.english: He spent too much money this month, so he can't even pay his water and electricity bills and rent.

examples.chinese: 收到帳單的時候得準時去繳費，以免超過時間後得繳更多錢。
examples.pinyin: Shōudào zhàngdān de shíhou děi zhǔnshí qù jiǎofèi, yǐmiǎn chāoguò shíjiān hòu děi jiǎo gèng duō qián.
examples.english: When you receive the bill, you must go pay it on time, so as to avoid having to pay more money after the deadline.

examples.chinese: 做任何事以前要先想清楚，這麼做會有什麼後果。
examples.pinyin: Zuò rènhé shì yǐqián yào xiān xiǎng qīngchu, zhème zuò huì yǒu shénme hòuguǒ.
examples.english: Before doing anything, you must first think clearly what consequences doing so will have.

examples.chinese: 今年學校的預算只夠修理宿舍的衛生設備，其他需要改善的只能等到明年了。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián xuéxiào de yùsuàn zhǐ gòu xiūlǐ sùshè de wèishēng shèbèi, qítā xūyào gǎishàn de zhǐ néng děng dào míngnián le.
examples.english: This year the school's budget is only enough to repair the dormitory's sanitary facilities; other things that need improvement can only wait until next year.

examples.english: If you go traveling, I have a way to let you have the richest itinerary with the smallest budget.

examples.chinese: 從小時候起，他的第一志願就是當一位保護國家的軍人。

examples.english: Since childhood, his first aspiration has been to be a soldier who protects the country.

items.wordHook: an 免(escape) shape takes one dot as a tail → one hopping 兔(rabbit).
Combining 十(ten) laborers with the united strength 劦(combined strength) of many enables teams to 協(assist).
夜(night) + 市(market) → a market that comes alive at night.
a 竹(bamboo) tally holds the 合(join) at the desk → a ready 答(answer).
